name: Starry Nebulon Quasarpants
description: Night windows, orbit lines and star charts. Has never been to space, but has strong opinions on it.

designs.title: Ringed Planet
designs.description: A banded planet with fine rings, cut out of a round black night full of stars.

designs.title: Moon Phases
designs.description: Five phases of the moon across a black band, with a small row of stars above and below.

designs.title: Great Comet
designs.description: A stippled comet head trailing a long black fan of tail through a few sharp stars.

designs.title: Total Eclipse
designs.description: A black disc with a wild corona flaring around it and small stars set into the dark.

designs.title: Constellation Chart
designs.description: A round star chart with four made-up constellations on a dotted grid and a ticked rim.

designs.title: Orbit Diagram
designs.description: Four thin orbits around a rayed sun, each carrying a different small world.
